name: Fel Rock
summary: North of Dolanaar, Fel Rock has fallen under a spreading corruption. Lord Melenas and his grells have turned the once-tranquil cavern into a threat within Teldrassil’s woods.

sections.title: A Den of Corruption
sections.body: North of Dolanaar, Fel Rock lies among Teldrassil’s forested hills. Once a peaceful cavern in wood and stone, it is now overtaken by twisted roots, unnatural shadows, wild grells and grellkin. The taint reaches into the world tree’s boughs.

sections.title: The Satyr's Hold
sections.body: Lord Melenas, a satyr, has claimed Fel Rock as his stronghold. From within the cavern, he spreads corruption beneath the watch of the night elf sentinels. Druids in Dolanaar, including Tallonkai Swiftroot, seek defenders to cleanse the cave and slay Melenas before the blight reaches farther into the surrounding woodlands.

faq.answer: Fel Rock lies in the hills directly north of Dolanaar, in central Teldrassil.
Lord Melenas, a satyr, commands Fel Rock and has gathered grells to do his bidding.

faq.q: Why are druids concerned about Fel Rock?
faq.answer: A satyr and fel-tainted grells threaten Teldrassil’s natural balance. Druids such as Tallonkai Swiftroot send defenders to slay Lord Melenas and stem the corruption.

faq.q: What creatures dwell inside the cavern?
faq.answer: Fel Rock is home to aggressive grells, grellkin and their master, the satyr Lord Melenas.

angles.text: For the Kaldorei, Lord Melenas and his hold so close to Dolanaar threaten Teldrassil and call for swift retribution.
As a druid of the Cenarion Circle, you see Fel Rock’s corruption as a wound in the young world tree, one that must be purged before the blight spreads.
